result.instructions: Tools for Zeffy, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which campaigns are open right now, and how close is each to its goal?"; "List the donations received this month, with campaign and fund."; "Find the contact for jane@example.org and show their total contribution.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Zeffy data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run zeffy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run zeffy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run zeffy_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. zeffy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: zeffy_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a new contact in the organization. Fails with a conflict when a contact with this email already exists; use zeffy_upsert_contact to update instead. Needs the organization's Stripe verification. Zeffy API: POST /api/v1/contacts.

email.description: Email address of the new contact.

address.description: Postal address. Send all five fields or none.

country.description: Country code or name, as Zeffy accepts it.

tools.name: zeffy_upsert_contact
tools.title: Create or update a contact by email
tools.description: Create the contact with this email, or update it when it exists. Safe to repeat with the same input. Needs the organization's Stripe verification. Zeffy API: PUT /api/v1/contacts.

email.description: Email address that identifies the contact.

address.description: Postal address. Send all five fields or none.

country.description: Country code or name, as Zeffy accepts it.
